title: A Quaternion--BCH Framework for the Local Accuracy of SIDER Interpolation
summary: Spherical Interpolation of orDER $n$ (SIDER-$n$) is a recursive high-order interpolation method for data on the unit sphere $\mathbb{S}^2$, built from repeated spherical linear interpolation (SLERP). This paper develops a quaternion--Lie algebra framework for proving the local consistency of SIDER for smooth spherical curves sampled at equally spaced parameter values. Points on $\mathbb{S}$ are represented as pure unit quaternions, and interpolation errors are measured in fixed-base quaternion logarithmic coordinates.
